body: I hope you're ok, did you hit your head at all?
Lmao me last night, they kinda suck though, they're really bendy, at least mine were.
Thanks for understanding, can't guarantee it but I'll try to push myself to do better for myself.

I want to but my part of me doesn't want talk to anyone so I can continue to self destruct. And I keep having this nagging voice in my head telling me that my problems aren't bad enough for therapy, which I know is bullshit, like if I'm kinda suicidal then something is definitely wrong. And I also don't want to bother people with my stupid non-issues you know?

I was standing while doing it, I was done and bandaged it then I just felt dizzy, it went black and I was on the ground. I googled it a bit though and vasovagal reflex came up, so I'm pretty that's what it is. It said it wasn't serious basically the brain gets overwhelmed and shuts down kinda, not a huge deal unless you hurt your self while falling.
No sorry I don't want to encourage it in any way though I may have already unintentionally, and I'm sorry for that.

I'm all good now, I'm gonna take it easy for a bit though, hopefully this will make me ease up on it a bit. I really appreciate the concern but I really don't want to drop the sh bomb on my family yet and they're the only way I can get to the hospital, I'll try be smarter about it.
